mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (measured as the month-over-month change in FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in declining rate periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS above 160000) and weak industrial production (INDPRO below 100.0) indicates a supply-demand mismatch that increases inflationary pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 160000 and INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year), a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the central bank aggressively tightens policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: In high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), the correlation between FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and negative SPX returns is not significant (Rank IC < -0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1280.0 (thousands of units) indicates weakening residential construction activity that reduces consumer spending and business investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST < 1280.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 725000.0 (millions of dollars) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 725000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A recent increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% within the past 5 trading days signals an immediate tightening of monetary policy that causes short-term equity market volatility and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
